description: getProjectCheck (GET /v2/projects/{projectIdOrName}/checks/{checkId}) omits the 404 the live API returns for a missing check (probed 2026-08-13: status 404, code 'check_not_found', message 'Check not found for ownerId: …, projectId: …, checkId: …'), so distilled's typed union lacks NotFound. The Check provider's observe step (getProjectCheck -> missing -> recreate) branches on the typed NotFound tag; without it the 404 surfaces as the out-of-union status class. Add the 404 response so the generator attaches NotFound.
